course.programmeTitle: Bachelor of Engineering in Data Science and Engineering
course.title: Personal Development and Teamwork
course.description: This course develops students’ personal and professional competencies with a strong emphasis on health and well-being, self-management, and teamwork. Students explore physical, mental, and workplace well-being, along with stress management strategies to enhance academic performance and quality of life. Through experiential learning, reflective practices, and collaborative activities aligned with CDIO and OBE principles, students build self-awareness, manage stress effectively, and work productively in teams. The course integrates health knowledge with practical personal development skills, preparing students to maintain well-being while performing effectively in academic and professional environments.

clos.description: Explain key concepts of health, stress management, and workplace well-being
clos.teachingMethodsRaw: - Interactive lectures (health concepts, stress theory, workplace well-being) - Case-based discussion (real-life health and lifestyle scenarios) - Video-based learning (mental health, lifestyle habits) - Guided reading and concept summarization - Instructor questioning and concept checking
clos.assessmentMethodsRaw: - Reflection Journal (20%) → assess understanding of health concepts - Final Personal Development & Wellness Portfolio (30%) → evaluate conceptual integration and understanding

clos.description: Apply personal management and stress-management strategies to improve well-being and performance
clos.teachingMethodsRaw: - Demonstration of stress-management techniques (breathing, mindfulness, time management) - Guided practice sessions (in-class exercises) - Habit tracking and self-monitoring activities - Instructor coaching and feedback - Scenario-based application tasks
clos.assessmentMethodsRaw: - Stress/Well-being Practice Log (25%) → assess application and consistency - Final Personal Development & Wellness Portfolio (30%) → evaluate application and personal improvement plan

clos.description: Demonstrate effective teamwork and communication skills in health and well-being related activities
clos.teachingMethodsRaw: - Role-play activities (communication, conflict handling) - Group discussions and collaborative problem-solving - Team-based project work - Peer feedback and reflection activities - Instructor facilitation and observation of teamwork behavior
clos.assessmentMethodsRaw: - Group Teamwork Project & Presentation (25%) → assess teamwork, communication, collaboration - Peer evaluation (embedded in project)

topics.title: Introduction to Health, Personal Development & Well-being
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Define key concepts of health, personal development, and well-being. LLO2: Explain the relationship between well-being and academic performance. LLO3: Identify personal strengths and areas for improvement. LLO4: Reflect on individual goals for personal development.

topics.title: Dimensions of Health (Physical, Mental, Social)
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Describe the three main dimensions of health. LLO2: Explain how different dimensions of health influence each other. LLO3: Identify behaviors that support each dimension. LLO4: Assess personal health status across dimensions.

topics.title: Mental Health & Academic Stress
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Explain the concept of mental health. LLO2: Identify common sources of academic stress. LLO3: Describe the effects of stress on performance. LLO4: Recognize early signs of stress and burnout.

topics.title: Stress Management Techniques
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Demonstrate basic stress-management techniques. LLO2: Apply strategies to manage academic stress. LLO3: Practice time management techniques. LLO4: Select appropriate coping strategies.

topics.title: Mindfulness & Emotional Control
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Describe mindfulness and emotional control. LLO2: Practice guided mindfulness exercises. LLO3: Apply emotional regulation strategies. LLO4: Demonstrate awareness of emotional responses.

topics.title: Sleep, Energy & Productivity
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Explain the role of sleep in performance. LLO2: Identify factors affecting sleep quality. LLO3: Monitor personal sleep habits. LLO4: Develop strategies to improve energy levels.

topics.title: Nutrition for Performance & Health
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Explain the relationship between nutrition and performance. LLO2: Identify healthy and unhealthy eating habits. LLO3: Describe basic nutritional needs. LLO4: Evaluate personal dietary habits.

topics.title: Digital Wellness & Lifestyle Balance
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Explain the impact of digital technology on health. LLO2: Analyze personal digital usage patterns. LLO3: Apply strategies to reduce digital fatigue. LLO4: Demonstrate healthy technology practices.

topics.title: Healthy Habits & Behavior Change
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Explain principles of habit formation. LLO2: Identify unhealthy habits. LLO3: Apply behavior change strategies. LLO4: Develop a habit improvement plan.

topics.title: Workplace Well-being & Professional Behavior
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Describe workplace well-being concepts. LLO2: Explain professional behavior expectations. LLO3: Identify factors affecting productivity. LLO4: Recognize importance of health in workplace.

topics.title: Communication Skills for Teamwork
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Explain principles of effective communication. LLO2: Demonstrate verbal and non-verbal communication. LLO3: Practice active listening. LLO4: Provide constructive feedback.

topics.title: Teamwork & Collaboration Skills
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Describe characteristics of effective teamwork. LLO2: Identify team roles and responsibilities. LLO3: Demonstrate collaboration in tasks. LLO4: Reflect on team contribution.

topics.title: Conflict Management & Group Dynamics
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Identify causes of conflict in teams. LLO2: Explain conflict resolution strategies. LLO3: Demonstrate respectful communication. LLO4: Apply problem-solving in conflicts.

topics.title: Team Project Presentation
topics.llosRaw: LLO1: Organize and present group work effectively. LLO2: Demonstrate teamwork during presentation. LLO3: Respond to questions appropriately. LLO4: Evaluate team performance.

studentResponsibilitiesRaw: Read the learning materials beforehand which means to be ready for the next session. Be completely engaged in class, active, take notes, and ask questions in class. Students are required to participate in various activities in and out of the classroom, such as group work, and individual homework for assignments and reports assigned by the subject teacher. Submit the assigned tasks such as homework, assignments, or research proposal on time.
coursePolicyRaw: Attendance & Preparation Students are expected to attend all classes (online/on-site). Assigned readings and preparation outlines must be completed before class if any. Active participation in group discussions and post-chapter evaluations is required. Academic Integrity All assignments, quizzes, and exams must be done individually. Academic misconduct includes: - Presenting others’ work as one’s own. - Engaging in plagiarism or cheating. Homework & Assignments Preparation outlines must be submitted on time; late submissions incur penalties. Peer discussion is encouraged, but midterm and final exams must be independent. Examinations Midterm and final exams are closed-book. Penalties Violations of academic integrity may result in a failing grade and referral to the Office of Student Affairs. Students uncertain about potential violations should consult the instructor in advance.
